nodes.description: Public state variable holding the AggregatorInterface oracle address that read() queries.
Public state variable storing the 10**decimals scaling factor applied to oracle output.
Constructor that stores the oracle address and computes priceMultiplier from the decimals argument.
External view function that reads latestAnswer() from the oracle and scales it with priceMultiplier.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow check (c / a == b).
SafeMath division with division-by-zero check.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow check (b <= a).
SafeMath addition with overflow check (c >= a).
SafeMath modulo with zero-divisor check.
External call to oracle.latestAnswer() on an arbitrary, deployer-supplied AggregatorInterface, whose returned int256 is trusted and cast to uint256.
Exponentiation 10 ** _priceMultiplierDecimals performed in the constructor without an overflow bound on the exponent.
Multiplication of the oracle output by priceMultiplier via SafeMath.mul used to scale the price to 18 decimals.
Constructor parameter _oracle: address of the aggregator being adapted.
Constructor parameter _priceMultiplierDecimals: decimal places used to build priceMultiplier.
Local variable in read() holding the uint256-cast result of oracle.latestAnswer().
Parameter a of SafeMath.mul (multiplicand).
Parameter b of SafeMath.mul (multiplier).

Parameter b of SafeMath.div (divisor).
Parameter a of SafeMath.sub (minuend).
Parameter b of SafeMath.sub (subtrahend).
Parameter a of SafeMath.add (first addend).
Parameter b of SafeMath.add (second addend).
Parameter a of SafeMath.mod (dividend).
Parameter b of SafeMath.mod (modulus).

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the supplied aggregator address into the oracle state variable.
Constructor writes the computed scaling factor into the priceMultiplier state variable.
Constructor entry point receives the _oracle argument.
Constructor entry point receives the _priceMultiplierDecimals argument.
Constructor parameter _oracle flows directly into the oracle state variable.
Constructor parameter _priceMultiplierDecimals is used as the exponent of 10 ** decimals.
Result of the exponentiation is stored into priceMultiplier.
The oracle state variable (attacker-influenced address) is the target of the external latestAnswer() call.
read() executes the external oracle.latestAnswer() call.
Return value of the external oracle call is cast to uint256 and stored in oracleOutput.
Local oracleOutput is multiplied by the scaling factor.
priceMultiplier state variable is consumed by the multiplication operation.
read() invokes SafeMath.mul to scale the price.
Scaled multiplication result is returned from read().
SafeMath.mul receives parameter a.
SafeMath.mul receives parameter b.
SafeMath.div receives parameter a.
SafeMath.div receives parameter b.
SafeMath.sub receives parameter a.
SafeMath.sub receives parameter b.
SafeMath.add receives parameter a.
SafeMath.add receives parameter b.
SafeMath.mod receives parameter a.
SafeMath.mod receives parameter b.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter is only consumed by the constructor and is immediately written into the oracle state variable.
The decimals parameter exists solely to compute priceMultiplier through the exponentiation operation.
The local oracleOutput is a transient value consumed only by the price scaling multiplication.
